quotes: The tuition fee for this program is 6,500 USD/Year
This is a 3-year program consisting of 6 academic semesters
This is supplemented by the application fee of $150 USD (one-time) and the entrance procedure fee of $350 USD
All courses are taught in English ; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
Admission requires a high school certificate and passing entrance exams in Chemistry and Mathematics.
